translation: Kimberly?!

source_text: It’s been fun. But we’ve gotten what we need.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx>.It’s been fun. But we’ve gotten what we need.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx>.It’s been fun. But we’ve gotten what we need."

translation: Było fajnie, ale mamy już to, czego potrzebowałyśmy.

source_text: It’s okay, 1Hero. Everything will be fine in the end.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.It’s okay, 1Hero. Everything will be fine in the end.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.It’s okay, 1Hero. Everything will be fine in the end."

translation: Spokojnie, 1Hero. Wszystko dobrze się skończy.

source_text: Very funny. Come back and unlock these cuffs.

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.Very funny. Come back and unlock these cuffs.
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.Very funny. Come back and unlock these cuffs."

translation: Bardzo śmieszne. Wróć i zdejmij mi kajdanki.

source_text: Judy! Kimberly! You’re just going to leave me here like this?!

structure.raw_value: McShCl.Judy! Kimberly! You’re just going to leave me here like this?!
structure.script_literal: "McShCl.Judy! Kimberly! You’re just going to leave me here like this?!"

translation: Judy! Kimberly! Naprawdę mnie tak tu zostawicie?!

source_text: How the hell am I going to get out of this?

structure.raw_value: McMaCl.How the hell am I going to get out of this?
structure.script_literal: "McMaCl.How the hell am I going to get out of this?"

translation: Jak się, do cholery, z tego wydostanę?

source_text: Whoo, I’m looking forward to changing out of uniform and getting some good exercise.

structure.raw_value: BoBaOp.Whoo, I’m looking forward to changing out of uniform and getting some good exercise.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaOp.Whoo, I’m looking forward to changing out of uniform and getting some good exercise."

translation: Uff, nie mogę się doczekać, aż zdejmę mundur i porządnie poćwiczę.

source_text: Hmm, seems I’m all alone…

structure.raw_value: BoFlOp.Hmm, seems I’m all alone…
structure.script_literal: "BoFlOp.Hmm, seems I’m all alone…"

translation: Hmm, chyba jestem sam…

source_text: Time to check the peephole.

structure.raw_value: BoHaOp.Time to check the peephole.
structure.script_literal: "BoHaOp.Time to check the peephole."

translation: Czas zajrzeć przez wizjer.

source_text: 1Hero?!

structure.raw_value: BoShClNo1.1Hero?!
structure.script_literal: "BoShClNo1.1Hero?!"

translation: 1Hero?!

source_text: Hahahaha!

structure.raw_value: BoFlOpNo2.Hahahaha!
structure.script_literal: "BoFlOpNo2.Hahahaha!"

translation: Hahahaha!

source_text: Smooth moves, pervert! You gave away your secret!

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.Smooth moves, pervert! You gave away your secret!
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.Smooth moves, pervert! You gave away your secret!"

translation: Nieźle, zboczeńcu! Zdradziłeś swoją tajemnicę!

source_text: Get over here and uncuff me.

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.Get over here and uncuff me.
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.Get over here and uncuff me."

translation: Chodź tu i zdejmij mi kajdanki.

source_text: What are you doing cuffed in the women’s changing room?

structure.raw_value: BoFlOp.What are you doing cuffed in the women’s changing room?
structure.script_literal: "BoFlOp.What are you doing cuffed in the women’s changing room?"

translation: Co ty robisz w kajdankach w damskiej przebieralni?

source_text: Take a wild guess.

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.Take a wild guess.
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.Take a wild guess."

translation: Zgadnij.

source_text: Hahahaha! Who was the lucky girl?

structure.raw_value: BoFrOpNo2.Hahahaha! Who was the lucky girl?
structure.script_literal: "BoFrOpNo2.Hahahaha! Who was the lucky girl?"

translation: Hahaha! Która szczęściara?

source_text: Ha ha, Bobby. Laugh it up.

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.Ha ha, Bobby. Laugh it up.
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.Ha ha, Bobby. Laugh it up."

translation: Ha, ha, Bobby. Śmiej się, póki możesz.

source_text: Maybe you could try unlocking these cuffs?

structure.raw_value: McAnCl.Maybe you could try unlocking these cuffs?
structure.script_literal: "McAnCl.Maybe you could try unlocking these cuffs?"

translation: Może spróbujesz zdjąć te kajdanki?

source_text: With an attitude like that? Why should I?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.With an attitude like that? Why should I?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.With an attitude like that? Why should I?"

translation: Z takim nastawieniem? A niby dlaczego?

source_text: I’m thinking a better idea is to bring everyone by to see the show.

structure.raw_value: BoFlDe.I’m thinking a better idea is to bring everyone by to see the show.
structure.script_literal: "BoFlDe.I’m thinking a better idea is to bring everyone by to see the show."

translation: Lepiej zawołam wszystkich, żeby obejrzeli przedstawienie.

source_text: And I’ll tell the whole world you watched it through the peephole.

structure.raw_value: McMaClNo1.And I’ll tell the whole world you watched it through the peephole.
structure.script_literal: "McMaClNo1.And I’ll tell the whole world you watched it through the peephole."

translation: A ja opowiem całemu światu, że podglądałeś przez wizjer.

source_text: Listen here, Canmore. You’ve got a lot of nerve.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.Listen here, Canmore. You’ve got a lot of nerve.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.Listen here, Canmore. You’ve got a lot of nerve."

translation: Słuchaj, Canmore. Masz tupet.

source_text: Bobby!

structure.raw_value: McMaClNo1.Bobby!
structure.script_literal: "McMaClNo1.Bobby!"

translation: Bobby!

source_text: No, Canmore! It’s your turn to listen! It’s time someone put you in your place, and I’ve been waiting a long time for this.

structure.raw_value: BoMaDeNo1.No, Canmore! It’s your turn to listen! It’s time someone put you in your place, and I’ve been waiting a long time for this.
structure.script_literal: "BoMaDeNo1.No, Canmore! It’s your turn to listen! It’s time someone put you in your place, and I’ve been waiting a long time for this."

translation: Nie, Canmore! Teraz ty posłuchasz. Ktoś wreszcie musi sprowadzić cię na ziemię, a ja czekam na tę chwilę od dawna.

source_text: From the day you got here, you made it clear you think you’re better than everyone else.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.From the day you got here, you made it clear you think you’re better than everyone else.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.From the day you got here, you made it clear you think you’re better than everyone else."

translation: Od dnia, w którym się tu pojawiłeś, zachowujesz się, jakbyś był lepszy od wszystkich.

source_text: Ignoring what you’re told, going off to do your own thing…

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Ignoring what you’re told, going off to do your own thing…
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Ignoring what you’re told, going off to do your own thing…"

translation: Ignorujesz polecenia i robisz wszystko po swojemu…

source_text: People talk. We all know the score with you.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.People talk. We all know the score with you.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.People talk. We all know the score with you."

translation: Ludzie gadają. Wszyscy wiemy, co z tobą jest.

source_text: Despite your constant insubordination, Kimura gave you a chance and you blew it because you can’t stop fucking around.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Despite your constant insubordination, Kimura gave you a chance and you blew it because you can’t stop fucking around.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Despite your constant insubordination, Kimura gave you a chance and you blew it because you can’t stop fucking around."

translation: Mimo twojego ciągłego nieposłuszeństwa Kimura dała ci szansę, a ty ją zmarnowałeś, bo nie umiesz przestać odwalać.

source_text: And usually, officers have to go through a lot of training before they’re allowed to go out armed.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.And usually, officers have to go through a lot of training before they’re allowed to go out armed.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.And usually, officers have to go through a lot of training before they’re allowed to go out armed."

translation: Zwykle funkcjonariusze przechodzą spore szkolenie, zanim dostaną broń.

source_text: Not just a little target practice. Tests, learning rules, and let’s not forget the most important part: safety lessons.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.Not just a little target practice. Tests, learning rules, and let’s not forget the most important part: safety lessons.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.Not just a little target practice. Tests, learning rules, and let’s not forget the most important part: safety lessons."

translation: Nie chodzi tylko o postrzelanie do tarczy. Są testy, nauka przepisów i najważniejsze: szkolenie z bezpieczeństwa.

source_text: You could kill someone with that thing, you know.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.You could kill someone with that thing, you know.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.You could kill someone with that thing, you know."

translation: Wiesz, że możesz kogoś tym zabić?

source_text: With all the free passes you get, did you learn some humility and gratitude?

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.With all the free passes you get, did you learn some humility and gratitude?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.With all the free passes you get, did you learn some humility and gratitude?"

translation: Dostałeś tyle taryf ulgowych, a nauczyłeś się choć trochę pokory i wdzięczności?

source_text: Nope, not Detective Canmore. He just takes it in stride that he deserves it all.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.Nope, not Detective Canmore. He just takes it in stride that he deserves it all.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.Nope, not Detective Canmore. He just takes it in stride that he deserves it all."

translation: Nie, detektyw Canmore uważa, że wszystko mu się należy.

source_text: But I’m the asshole here, huh?

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.But I’m the asshole here, huh?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.But I’m the asshole here, huh?"

translation: Ale to ja jestem tu dupkiem, tak?

source_text: Hold on, I think something’s wrong with my ears. Let me clear them out.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Hold on, I think something’s wrong with my ears. Let me clear them out.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Hold on, I think something’s wrong with my ears. Let me clear them out."

translation: Chwila, chyba coś mi się stało ze słuchem. Zaraz sobie przeczyszczę uszy.

source_text: I’ve been ungrateful and arrogant. I keep making a lot of mistakes.

structure.raw_value: McSaCl.I’ve been ungrateful and arrogant. I keep making a lot of mistakes.
structure.script_literal: "McSaCl.I’ve been ungrateful and arrogant. I keep making a lot of mistakes."

translation: Byłem niewdzięczny i arogancki. Ciągle popełniam mnóstwo błędów.

source_text: I’m sorry I’ve been such a jerk.

structure.raw_value: McSaCl.I’m sorry I’ve been such a jerk.
structure.script_literal: "McSaCl.I’m sorry I’ve been such a jerk."

translation: Przepraszam, że byłem takim dupkiem.

source_text: Alright, I’ll unlock the cuffs.

structure.raw_value: BoBaOp.Alright, I’ll unlock the cuffs.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaOp.Alright, I’ll unlock the cuffs."

translation: Dobra, zdejmę te kajdanki.

source_text: Come clean with me, Canmore… What the hell is going on with you and Kimura?

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.Come clean with me, Canmore… What the hell is going on with you and Kimura?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.Come clean with me, Canmore… What the hell is going on with you and Kimura?"

translation: Powiedz mi prawdę, Canmore… Co jest między tobą a Kimurą?

source_text: Something big is happening, Bobby… Kimura won’t be here much longer.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Something big is happening, Bobby… Kimura won’t be here much longer.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Something big is happening, Bobby… Kimura won’t be here much longer."

translation: Dzieje się coś poważnego, Bobby… Kimura niedługo stąd wyjedzie.

source_text: Why? What makes you say that?

structure.raw_value: BoWoOp.Why? What makes you say that?
structure.script_literal: "BoWoOp.Why? What makes you say that?"

translation: Dlaczego? Co takiego?

source_text: The Guild case isn’t over… In fact, it’s far more complex than you probably realize.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The Guild case isn’t over… In fact, it’s far more complex than you probably realize.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The Guild case isn’t over… In fact, it’s far more complex than you probably realize."

translation: Sprawa Gildii jeszcze się nie skończyła… Jest dużo bardziej złożona, niż myślisz.

source_text: You think I don’t know that? You think my men get called away from the mansion without explanation and I don’t get suspicious?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.You think I don’t know that? You think my men get called away from the mansion without explanation and I don’t get suspicious?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.You think I don’t know that? You think my men get called away from the mansion without explanation and I don’t get suspicious?"

translation: Myślisz, że o tym nie wiem? Moi ludzie są wzywani z rezydencji bez wyjaśnienia. Miałbym nie nabrać podejrzeń?

source_text: I might need help from you and your men.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I might need help from you and your men.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I might need help from you and your men."

translation: Może będę potrzebował pomocy twojej i twoich ludzi.

source_text: I need to go… Guild goons are going to try and take over the Channel 4 building.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I need to go… Guild goons are going to try and take over the Channel 4 building.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I need to go… Guild goons are going to try and take over the Channel 4 building."

translation: Muszę iść… Bandyci z Gildii spróbują przejąć budynek Channel 4.

source_text: But… They are not normal henchmen… They will be very hard to take down.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.But… They are not normal henchmen… They will be very hard to take down.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.But… They are not normal henchmen… They will be very hard to take down."

translation: Ale to nie są zwykli pachołkowie… Będzie ich trudno powstrzymać.

source_text: Why didn’t anyone tell me?

structure.raw_value: BoShEx.Why didn’t anyone tell me?
structure.script_literal: "BoShEx.Why didn’t anyone tell me?"

translation: Dlaczego nikt mi nie powiedział?

source_text: Listen, Bobby. Kimura doesn’t know about any of this. She’s leaving the country.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Listen, Bobby. Kimura doesn’t know about any of this. She’s leaving the country.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Listen, Bobby. Kimura doesn’t know about any of this. She’s leaving the country."

translation: Posłuchaj, Bobby. Kimura o niczym nie wie. Wyjeżdża z kraju.

source_text: Pull together some men and meet at the Channel 4 building. And be quiet about it.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Pull together some men and meet at the Channel 4 building. And be quiet about it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Pull together some men and meet at the Channel 4 building. And be quiet about it."

translation: Zbierz kilku ludzi i spotkajcie się pod budynkiem Channel 4. I nie rozpowiadajcie o tym.

source_text: You really trust me?

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.You really trust me?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.You really trust me?"

translation: Naprawdę mi ufasz?

source_text: You uncuffed me, didn’t you?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.You uncuffed me, didn’t you?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.You uncuffed me, didn’t you?"

translation: Przecież zdjąłeś mi kajdanki, prawda?

source_text: That I did.

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.That I did.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.That I did."

translation: To prawda.

source_text: And besides, if you don’t help me, I’ll tell the whole office about the peephole.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.And besides, if you don’t help me, I’ll tell the whole office about the peephole.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.And besides, if you don’t help me, I’ll tell the whole office about the peephole."

translation: Poza tym, jeśli mi nie pomożesz, opowiem całemu biuru o tym wizjerze.

source_text: Let’s not be rash.

structure.raw_value: BoWoCl.Let’s not be rash.
structure.script_literal: "BoWoCl.Let’s not be rash."

translation: Nie wyciągajmy pochopnych wniosków.

source_text: See you there, Bobby.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.See you there, Bobby.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.See you there, Bobby."

translation: Do zobaczenia, Bobby.

source_text: Well… This will probably backfire… But what choice do we have?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Well… This will probably backfire… But what choice do we have?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Well… This will probably backfire… But what choice do we have?"

translation: No cóż… Pewnie się to na nas zemści… Ale co innego możemy zrobić?

source_text: What the hell!? Where did my amulet go?...

structure.raw_value: McWoClNo1^.What the hell!? Where did my amulet go?...
structure.script_literal: "McWoClNo1^.What the hell!? Where did my amulet go?..."

translation: Co do cholery?! Gdzie się podział mój amulet?...

source_text: The girls must have taken it!

structure.raw_value: McWoOp^.The girls must have taken it!
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp^.The girls must have taken it!"

translation: Dziewczyny musiały go zabrać!

source_text: Shit… That means Lillian will have all three…

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.Shit… That means Lillian will have all three…
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.Shit… That means Lillian will have all three…"

translation: Cholera… To znaczy, że Lillian będzie miała wszystkie trzy…

source_text: What does it mean?

structure.raw_value: McSaDe^.What does it mean?
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe^.What does it mean? "

translation: Co to znaczy?

source_text: This is the ladies room, 1Hero… Did you make a wrong turn?

structure.raw_value: MeFlOp.This is the ladies room, 1Hero… Did you make a wrong turn?
structure.script_literal: "MeFlOp.This is the ladies room, 1Hero… Did you make a wrong turn?"

translation: To damska toaleta, 1Hero… Zbłądziłeś?

source_text: I won and now we’re going to fuck.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I won and now we’re going to fuck.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I won and now we’re going to fuck."

translation: Wygrałem, więc teraz pójdziemy się pieprzyć.

source_text: We most certainly are not! Are you crazy?

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.We most certainly are not! Are you crazy?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnOp.We most certainly are not! Are you crazy?"

translation: Na pewno nie! Zwariowałeś?

source_text: That was the deal.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.That was the deal.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.That was the deal."

translation: Tak się umówiliśmy.

source_text: But you lost!

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.But you lost!
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.But you lost!"

translation: Ale przegrałeś!

source_text: No! I won!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.No! I won!
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.No! I won!"

translation: Nie! Wygrałem!
